rdf:Description.dc:description: Lonnie G. Bunch III is the director of the Smithsonian National Museum of African American History and Culture. He develops exhibits and public programs and coordinates the museum's mission. Under his leadership, the Museum opened an exhibit in the National Museum of American History on the Scurlock Studio, one of the foremost African American photography studios in the nation.
